rationale: The bullish-reversal thesis has not followed through — price has flatlined at $11.85 over five low-volume candles, pinned at the 5m 9-EMA ($11.84) and far below session VWAP ($12.18), while today's 6.68% gap-up has fully faded to just 10% of the range. With no fresh upside thrust and the intraday trend still lower, the position is more likely to drift into the $11.73 invalidation than to rally ~2.9% to the $12.19 target, so exiting flat preserves today's realized gains.
